mechanism_narrative: A sustained Federal Funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the policy stance remains supportive of risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise sequentially over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising Federal Funds rate signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during tightening cycles.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increased in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS increased in the last month over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 100,000 jobs indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 100,000 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1200 thousand units indicate weak residential construction activity that signals deteriorating consumer confidence and demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when HOUST < 1200 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in industrial production and quarterly GDP growth indicates robust economic output that elevates corporate earnings visibility, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through supply-side momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 rise sequentially over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous retail sales and housing starts above their 12-month moving averages indicate sustained consumer demand strength that accelerates corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST above their 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST both exceed their 12-month moving averages over any 2-year rolling window.
